# `preferEffectArray`

Suggests Effect Array APIs for native array member references, with semantic caveats

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Effect-native |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377139` |
| Language Service name | `preferEffectArray` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/prefer-effect-array` |

## Preview

```ts
import * as A from "effect/Array"

const values = [1, 2, 3]
export const native = values.find(n => n > 1)
/**
                             ^^^^ effecttsgo(prefer-effect-array): Consider effect/Array.findFirst instead of native Array.find. Returns Option, with None replacing undefined; the callback type accepts (value, index), with no array parameter or thisArg.
*/
export const preferred = A.findFirst(values, n => n > 1)
```
